title: Seamless tileable texture
description: A flat albedo tile whose edges wrap (the materials workflow).

body.subject: A seamless tileable texture, flat orthographic, edge to edge with no border and no vignette: {{material}} with {{motif}}.
body.action: The left edge must continue exactly into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge.
body.style: Flat albedo, no lighting, no shadows.

motif.default: a gold Greek-key (meander) embroidery band running horizontally across the middle
